text: Appeal of Order to Comply (June 11, 2018) for 273 Pharmacy Avenue, Parking Garage

Property Standards Committee, Scarborough Panel: 1. Confirmed Items 12, 14, and 20 of the order to comply (June 11, 2018) for 273 Pharmacy Avenue, Parking Garage, Folder No. 18 166524 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to August 15, 2018, to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City. 2. Confirmed Items 1-11, 13, and 15-19 of the order to comply (June 11, 2018) for 273 Pharmacy Avenue, Parking Garage, Folder No. 18 166524 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to August 30, 2019, to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
